claims.statement: A well-known man in the business said Tom Allen put up the first $250 forfeit for the Daly-McManus match.
claims.excerpt: Said to have stated that Allen put up the first

claims.statement: Tom Allen made the later forfeit deposits himself when the other parties did not come forward, until he had put up the whole $1,000.
claims.excerpt: Alien put that up also, and so on until

claims.statement: Dan Daly said McManus bluffed and challenged him in the theatres and got Tom Allen mixed up in the match.
claims.excerpt: was called down, and he got Tom Allen mixed

claims.statement: Dan Daly said Tom Allen and Hugh McManus were both sorry after they got into the match and then tried to get out of it.
claims.excerpt: Both of them were sorry after they got in and then went to work to get out

claims.statement: It is said Tom Allen stuck on technicalities to avoid the choice of fighting or forfeiting his $1,000.
claims.excerpt: induced the fat and festive Thomas to stick on

notes: The Daly-McManus fight was called off; Allen was a backer of McManus, not a fighter here. The claims rest on what was said to have been stated.
